_comment: Tier-2: backends.kratos.generators.KNOWLEDGE is the ONLY per-physics catalog the Kratos backend consumes, and data/kratos_knowledge exports per-application constants rather than a unified KRATOS_KNOWLEDGE dict — so a get_knowledge that wrapped `from kratos_knowledge import KRATOS_KNOWLEDGE` in try/except would silently run its fallback branch forever. Pitfall (kratos._auxiliary_overview #6). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). Verified against the repository as it stands: the generators catalog is a populated dict, the backend imports it, and the backend source contains no reference to kratos_knowledge at all — the dead branch the claim describes was removed and this fixture goes red if it is reintroduced. Kratos itself is imported at module scope so the fixture cannot report on a machine without it. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
